question: How are the palm and middle finger lengths derived from the forearm measure?
premises: Half of the forearm measure is the palm length.
The remainder is assigned to the middle finger.
inference: The palm is half the forearm length and the remainder constitutes the middle finger part.
uncertainties: The exact division implied by śeṣaṃ in this proportional scheme is compact.
plain_english: Half of that is the length of the palm, and the remainder is the part of the middle finger.
